summary: Iter6: Bug fixes (teacher create student / teacher excel upload), Sick Leaves (CRUD + cert upload + recurring), Audit filters + facets, Subscription guard middleware (opt-in). Backend pytest: 115/115 PASS (added 22 new iter6 tests under TestTeacherCreateStudent, TestTeacherUploadStudents, TestSickLeaves, TestAuditFilters, TestSubscriptionGuardMiddleware — all green). Iter5 regression on /api/analytics/student/{uid} (not_in_class KeyError) is now FIXED and verified. Frontend smoke green on teacher/school/parent/platform routes; one minor missing testid 'audit-clear' on AuditLogPage.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid='audit-clear' on the clear-filters button. All other 7 audit testids (search/role/action/resource/date-from/date-to/apply) are present and working on both /school/audit and /platform/audit.

action_items: Add data-testid='audit-clear' to the Clear / Reset button on /app/frontend/src/pages/shared/AuditLogPage.jsx (one-line fix; UI clear logic may currently rely on the page's own Reset link or there's no clear button rendered alongside Apply).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/sick_leaves.py — clean implementation. Auto-attendance upsert correctly skips weekends (d.weekday() < 5) and marks status='sick'. Cert upload caps at 5MB, validates MIME against (jpeg/png/webp/pdf). RBAC enforced via _student_in_scope helper which reuses _teacher_class_filter from students.py — DRY ✓.

routes/sick_leaves.py:_student_in_scope — uses tflt.get('$or', []) and matches (class_id, section). For teacher with no assigned classes (_blocked_) it raises 403. Verified parent-blocks-other-child and teacher-scoped list correctly.

routes/sick_leaves.py:list_leaves — teacher branch reads up to 2000 students for class match; ok for typical school size but if a single teacher were assigned 10+ sections this is fine. accounts role gets school-wide visibility (probably intentional for billing context).

routes/audit.py — supports actor_role/action/resource/school_id/date_from/date_to/q filters. Builds Mongo $regex i for free-text and ISO-datetime range filter on created_at. /facets returns distinct lists scoped to caller's school (or all for platform_admin). Non-admin gets empty {} — verified.

routes/audit.py — flt.setdefault('created_at', {}) pattern works when both date_from + date_to provided but leaves a small dead-code branch using 'created_at_str' that's immediately popped. Cosmetic cleanup possible but no functional issue.

core/subscription_guard.py — middleware properly gated by ENABLE_SUBSCRIPTION_GUARD env (off by default). Sanity test verifies writes still succeed and /health is open when middleware disabled. We did NOT enable the guard during this test run to avoid blocking parallel CRUD tests; main agent should run a one-off integration test with ENABLE_SUBSCRIPTION_GUARD=true on a backdated school to confirm 402 + code='subscription_expired' contract.

routes/uploads.py — POST /api/uploads/students payload expects raw class_id (and section) per row. The 'Bulk Uploads' template should make this very explicit to teachers — confirm UI side passes class_id (not class_name) from the dropdown.
routes/students.py:create_student — class-teacher gating using _teacher_class_filter verified: section A allowed for priya@sunrise.edu (PASS), section B rejected with 403 (PASS).
Iter5 regression FIXED & verified: TestAnalytics::test_student_analytics now PASSES (was failing with 500 KeyError on 'not_in_class' in iter5). The fix to /app/backend/routes/analytics.py is intact.

AuditLogPage missing 'audit-clear' testid is the only frontend gap observed across 4 critical routes (teacher /students, /uploads, /sick-leaves; school /sick-leaves, /audit; parent /sick-leaves; platform /audit).
